title: Who Will Inherit the World?

sourceEvidence.excerpt: Someone delays children until housing, work, finances and parenting conditions seem adequate. Another person belongs to a community that shares housing and care, making family formation easier. Neither needs to think about evolution. Their institutions have already changed the practical cost of becoming parents. The argument is not that prudent people inevitably disappear.
